title: DJI camera clone company Xtra is halting and refunding all preorders
summary: Last year, we showed you visually just how identical the Xtra Muse and DJI Osmo Pocket 3 truly are: Xtra didn’t immediately respond to a request for comment. Questions we’ve sent to DJI about Xtra, and other “DJI front companies,” remain unanswered.
